rows.result: MISBRANDED DRUG The drug product Diclofenac sodium and Paracetamol tablets is offcially included in the current edition of Indian Pharmacopoeia IP 2022 and as required as per second schedule of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 the said Product shall comply with the standards set out in the Indian Pharmacopoeia. But the designation IP in conjunction with the offcial title Diclofenac sodium and Paracetamol tablets on the label of the drug product was not mentioned as an indication that the drug product purports to comply with the IP satadards. Hence the drug product shall deemed to be MISBRANDED DRUG as per section 17 of Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 as it is not labelled in the prescribed Manner.
